summary: Re-reviewed after merging main (merge-base a153f90: structured problems, nodes without a GPU, secrets renderer, locale-neutral defaults, protocol spec). Behaviour-preserving refactor of node selection (router 0.37.1, ADR-0108 proposed). scheduler.assess replaces the mirrored candidates_for/_node_block judgement; candidates_for and choose no longer change state; the expired-open -> half_open breaker transition moved to scheduler.probe_breakers, called by the two request paths (proxy._Acquire before every choose, ops.run_shadow before its candidates_for); views never mutated and still do not. Budget arithmetic shares nodes.card_gib/Node.card_budget_gib, the measured-occupancy sum shares Node._real_gib (same float summation order), loading_for/tier_loading share one loop. Traced: B6/TM-05 - the cloud data-class and provider gate (Routing.tier_blocked, cloud.provider_block_reason) is unchanged and still applied in choose before any tier is judged; probe_breakers calls the same pure tier_blocked and only moves a breaker, it selects nothing and sends nothing; a cloud tier still yields a candidate only through candidates_for with the same breaker test. TM-08 (stage 3 breaker, admission): the probe reaches exactly the targets the old mutating selection reached (tiers not blocked by the request, not excluded, nodes offering the model and passing offline/draining/busy), so a failing node is probed once and re-opens on one failure as before; admission and deadlines untouched. B3: agent-reported facts (mem_pressure, upstream_blocked, standby_models, VRAM) are read as before and remain assertions of that host; no new trust in them. B1: the availability endpoint keeps its auth check and response fields; 503 blocker fields are unchanged except one corner the agent does not report (held server's model loaded while the standby serves, under memory pressure or the agent's RAM block), which now reports memory_pressure with the same RAM fields used elsewhere instead of no reason - no new data exposed. B9/TM-15: journal entries (breaker half_open, no_node blockers) keep their shape and content; no new logging. TM-16: ci.yml only gains one self-test line; no action, permission or review-policy change. No configuration, dependency, endpoint, agent or deployment change. Added text names no organisation, host, address or person. Merge with router 0.36.0 (ADR-0102, nodes without a GPU): the CPU-node sizing lives in the shared helpers, not in a second path - nodes.empty_room_gib = capacity_gib - reserve_gib (card, or main memory with the larger of reserve and memory_pressure.min_free_gib), Node.budget_gib keeps main's RAM branch (available RAM only when it is a number and the report is fresh, bool rejected) and falls back to the empty node, Node.prewarm_budget_gib holds main's GPU/CPU prewarm choice; assess and role_possible_when_free use the same too-large test. The agent's RAM figures stay assertions of that host (B3), used exactly as on main. problems.py (new on main) calls choose as a view without probe_breakers, as it passed mutate=False before; scheduler._node_block remains an alias of assess so tests written against it (selftest_cpu_node.py) run unchanged.

tests.evidence: 4224-state matrix (each state with and without a GPU): candidates_for, assess, blockers and choose agree; selection pure; probe_breakers moves exactly the due breakers past the state gate, nodes and a cloud provider. Earlier instrument check: four drifted schedulers each make it fail.

tests.command: differential comparison against the current origin/main scheduler/nodes (outside the repository, 20,000 random states)
tests.evidence: 14,011 of the generated nodes without a GPU (malformed RAM figures included); 0 mismatches in codes and facts, candidates, blockers/unavailable, loading waits, role_possible_when_free, choose on the request path (pick, breaker states, journal, routing record), shadow path, budget_gib, prewarm budget and residency room; only the documented release-and-loaded corner differs in its explanation. Injected divergences detected, including GPU-only room/prewarm on CPU nodes (2,900 mismatches).

tests.evidence: 80 commands, 0 failed (check_adr_index green with ADR-0101..0108); selftest_ollama_loopback and selftest_ollama_protected all passed.

tests.evidence: 334 PASS, 0 FAIL, STATE: passed (after the merge).

tests.evidence: All checks passed; configuration ok; control flow 0 findings.
Public-change scan: 0 finding(s); added lines reviewed manually.

limitations: A future request path that selects without calling probe_breakers would let an expired breaker through with the same verdict but without marking it half_open; both existing request paths call it, the self-test guards purity, not the callers.
The differential comparison ran on random synthetic states with stub catalog figures; it does not cover the proxy's wait/retry loop beyond the end-to-end suite.
The standby budget stays card-based on a node without a GPU, exactly as on main; a held OpenAI-compatible server with a standby Ollama on such a node is not a known setup and was not reviewed as one.

In WSL (Python 3.11 + PostgreSQL 16, after the merge) all self-tests and the four PostgreSQL integrations passed; red only were environment steps (git cannot read the Windows worktree, packaging missing in that venv, no pwsh), which pass on Windows.
